phase_name: Interactive Workflow Session Coordination & Publication Handoff Integration
summary: Implemented the Session Coordination and Publication Handoff Integration layer defined by IWC-001 v1.1 by composing the infrastructure delivered in Phases 143K-143N into a deterministic Interactive Workflow execution model. Read IWC-001 v1.1 (full text), CHGR-001, Phase 143J's implementation plan, Phase 143K/143L/143M/143N's reports and full package source, TAMC-001, TAMPC-001, and PROJECT_STATUS.md directly before writing any code. Implemented two new sibling packages: pcae.interactive_workflow.orchestration (WorkflowOrchestrator -- constructed via injection of all six 143K-143N/143L collaborators (EvidenceCoordinator, ClarificationController, AuditRecorder, PreviewBuilder, ConfirmationController, TransitionEngine) scoped to one session identifier; sole owner of workflow sequencing, component invocation order, and orchestration state via a fixed eight-stage OrchestrationState machine (Session Initialization, Evidence Availability, Clarification Lifecycle, Preview Construction, Preview Validation, Confirmation Request, Confirmation Validation, Terminal Workflow Completion); each stage method checks sequencing legality before delegating to exactly one collaborator's own existing public method, never re-implementing transition legality, evidence validation, clarification evaluation, Preview Digest generation, or audit serialization; no publish/notify/create_chgr/invoke_lifecycle method exists) and pcae.interactive_workflow.publication_handoff (PublicationReadinessPackage -- immutable, references-only: session id, session state, transition sequence number, evidence/clarification/audit refs, preview id/digest, confirmation request/response ids; deliberately carries no publication-state, publication-result, CHGR-identifier, or authority-token field; PublicationHandoff -- sole owner of package construction, completeness validation, and readiness exposure, requiring an already-Confirmed session, a complete OrchestrationState, and an already-accepted ConfirmationResponse as structural preconditions rather than re-running 143N's own staleness/replay/digest checks; a readiness interface only, per IWC-REQ-171's explicitly open Publication Handoff execution-ownership question -- no publish/notify/create_chgr/invoke_lifecycle method exists). SessionCoordinator gained build_orchestrator (pure assembly, constructs no collaborator itself) and now implements orchestrate_evidence/perform_confirmation as one-line orchestrator-delegating methods; perform_publication remains a permanent NotImplementedError (IWC-REQ-171 leaves Publication Handoff execution ownership an explicitly open question no phase, including this one, closes). Added one sibling serialization module (publication_handoff_schema.py, raising the new PublicationHandoffSerializationError) and extended errors.py with six new InteractiveWorkflowError subclasses (WorkflowInitializationError, MissingWorkflowComponentError, InvalidWorkflowSequenceError, PublicationHandoffIncompleteError, WorkflowCompositionError, PublicationHandoffSerializationError). state_machine/* (143L), evidence/clarification/audit (143M), and preview/confirmation (143N) were not modified. No publication, CHGR creation, lifecycle-command invocation, CLI workflow command, Web/API transport, or runtime execution capability implemented. See docs/PHASE_143O_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_SESSION_COORDINATION_AND_PUBLICATION_HANDOFF_INTEGRATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_iwc_143o_session_coordination_publication_handoff.py added: 46 new tests covering WorkflowOrchestrator construction (six-collaborator type validation via MissingWorkflowComponentError, cross-session-scope rejection via WorkflowCompositionError), deterministic eight-stage sequencing (each stage delegates to exactly one collaborator's own public method; out-of-order or duplicate stage invocation raises InvalidWorkflowSequenceError before any collaborator side effect; orchestration is repeatable/deterministic across two independent orchestrators given identical inputs), component invocation order and dependency isolation (no lateral component-to-component calls; TransitionEngine stored but never invoked by the orchestrator), Publication Readiness Package (immutability, field-set validation, forbidden-field absence -- no publication_state/publication_result/chgr_id/authority_token field), PublicationHandoff (build_package requires an already-Confirmed session, a complete OrchestrationState, and an accepted ConfirmationResponse -- raises PublicationHandoffIncompleteError otherwise; completeness validation; readiness determination; serialization round-trip via publication_handoff_schema.py, unsupported-schema-version rejection via PublicationHandoffSerializationError), boundary protection (no publish/notify/create_chgr/invoke_lifecycle method exists anywhere in orchestration/ or publication_handoff/, confirmed by dedicated negative/AST-based tests; runtime capability unchanged, confirmed via pcae runtime inspect), and Regression (SessionCoordinator.build_orchestrator/orchestrate_evidence/perform_confirmation now implemented; perform_publication remains a permanent NotImplementedError; EvidenceCoordinator/ClarificationController/AuditRecorder/PreviewBuilder/ConfirmationController/TransitionEngine independently re-exercised and unchanged). One pre-existing 143K regression test (test_coordinator_out_of_scope_methods_fail_deterministically) was narrowly adjusted to cover only the now-permanently-NotImplementedError perform_publication, since orchestrate_evidence/perform_confirmation are no longer zero-argument stubs. All 46 pass; 681 pass combined with 143K's 110, 143L's 400, 143M's 61, and 143N's 66.
